components: A probe calls the instance readiness or dependency-aware endpoint.
The instance reports whether it can safely serve new work.
Consecutive successes or failures prevent one noisy probe from deciding.
Unhealthy instances are removed from new-request routing.
Passing the recovery threshold returns the instance to service.
